In terms of abstraction, each module should not be caching dbus values individually.  If we want to tackle caching as a whole, we can, or if we want to tackle a "common" reactor library, we could do that too, but adding functions like this shouldn't happen.

Yes if we get to a place where we have common reactor library for caching then we can refactor this to use that. Until then we need to have this cache to support overall aggregation functionality with multi satmc where we don't hardcode the prefix information 

More than optimisation we need the SatMC configuration from EM locally available for function beginAggregation. 
Previously beginAggregation was just checking hardcoded prefix for just one satMC which is been enhanced now. 

The local SatMC info from EM helps with the next commit https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/79913/18. 

We are caching mostly static configuration from EM for the feature enhancement.

> . Until then we need to have this cache to support

Disagree.  Until then we can rely on the behavior as it has existed and deal with the minor performance impact.

@gunnar@gmills.xyz, what are your thoughts here. If we want to read prefix from EM then we need this cache. Should we go back to having prefix hardcoded in meson option ? this also means we cant support multiple SatMCs.
